description: Translate multiple texts at once with a single model pipeline invocation. Much faster than calling translate repeatedly for batch workloads. All texts must share the same source and target languages.

glossary.description: Optional term mapping applied to all texts in the batch.

source_lang.description: Source language code (same format as translate tool). All texts share this source language.

target_lang.description: Target language code (same format as translate tool). All texts share this target language.

texts.description: Array of text strings to translate

name: translate_batch
